test.name: Start research on an existing project — refuse, hand back to project-status, call no tool (direct-agent arm)
test.description: The agent's own guard clause, reached by direct spawn. A research.json already exists (mid-research-flynn) and the delegation is init-flavored ('Start research'). The agent must call no MCP tool, write nothing, and return the one caller-facing line 'Hand-back: project-status — <clause>'. Kept when init-project became an agent rather than deleted with the description-routing negatives: on the direct arm there is no router, so this grades the refuse-if-exists gate itself, the suite's only coverage of it. A DIRECT negative graded on its invariant (unit-test-spec.md 5.2.1): test_hand_back_names_its_owner and test_existing_project_is_not_reinitialized.

input.delegation:
Start research on this project — where do things stand and what should I work on next?

projectPath: <workspace>

negative.explanation: A research.json already exists, so init-project must not run: no person_read, person_search, place_search or project_create call, both project files unchanged, and a Hand-back line naming project-status, which reports where the project stands and recommends the next step. Graded on that invariant; on the direct arm no router runs, so correct_skill names the hand-back owner the validator reads, not a skill the harness waits to see invoked.

judge_context: Should decline to initialize (research.json already exists) and return a caller-facing 'Hand-back: project-status' line, not re-run the init workflow
Should make no MCP tool calls — no person_read, no person_search, no place_search, no project_create. One built-in Read of research.json to detect the project is the guard's own check, not init work
The researcher paragraph after the final '---' should say in plain language that a project already exists and nothing new was started; it must not name files, tools or fields
